source_batch.unit_label: BRBL::MOD_D::U28: Identify public duty,public servant and non-cash undue advantage

payload.title: An improper benefit need not be cash
payload.core_explanation_md:
The Prevention of Corruption Act uses defined public-duty and public-servant categories extending beyond a simple payroll label. The described categories include qualifying public bodies and persons performing the specified public functions. Government appointment is not the sole test. Establish the actual role and statutory category before concluding coverage.

Undue advantage concerns gratification other than legal remuneration and is not confined to money or a benefit that can readily be priced. A favour,service or other non-cash benefit cannot be dismissed solely because no cash changed hands. Equally,an authorised remuneration payment must be distinguished from an improper benefit. Analyse the benefit,purpose,recipient and duty rather than relying on a gift label.

self_check.prompt_text: Can a non-cash benefit fall within undue advantage?
self_check.expected_takeaway: Yes. The definition is not restricted to monetary gratification.

payload.stem_md: An official accepts a valuable service connected to an improper official favour and argues no undue advantage can exist because no money was paid. Which point matters?

options.text_md: The benefit need not be monetary
options.explanation_md: The act,purpose and statutory elements still need proof.

options.text_md: Every authorised salary payment is corruption
The service cannot be examined because it has no invoice
options.explanation_md: Invoice absence does not exclude the benefit.

payload.correct_explanation_md: The act,purpose and statutory elements still need proof.

payload.stem_md: A person performs a function within a specified public-servant category but was not appointed through a government recruitment process. What should be assessed?

options.explanation_md: Appointment mode is not the sole test.

options.text_md: A universal exclusion for anyone not government-appointed
Only the person private bank account
options.explanation_md: It does not settle the role.

options.text_md: The statutory public-servant category and actual function
options.explanation_md: Coverage depends on the legal definition and facts.

payload.correct_explanation_md: Coverage depends on the legal definition and facts.
